## 🚦 PR Submission Checklist

- [ ] My changes are located **strictly** within my personal directory: `STUDENTS/<my-github-username>/` (unless contributing globally to resources/leaderboard with admin permission).
- [ ] My branch is named following the format: `<name>/week-<number>` (e.g. `pranaw/week-01`).
- [ ] My commit messages follow the format: `feat(<username>): week-<number> progress`.
- [ ] I have linked any relevant issues (if applicable).
- [ ] I have verified that all markdown files render correctly on GitHub.
- [ ] I have self-reviewed my code and notes.
